# Free Resume Post — candidate resume platform

> Free Resume Post (freeresumepost.co) is a free candidate-side resume platform operated by Ava Health, a Tampa FL-based healthcare staffing and recruiting firm. Healthcare professionals upload a resume once and get matched to current openings on sister site freejobpost.co — without their resume being added to a recruiter database for resale.

The platform is candidate-controlled: profiles are public only with explicit opt-in, every match is a notification (not a recruiter pitch), and candidates can delete their profile and revoke all data at any time. Free for candidates. Free for employers — they post jobs on freejobpost.co, candidate matches appear in their dashboard.

## Core entry points

- [Upload your resume](https://www.freeresumepost.co/upload): Free 60-second resume upload — PDF, DOCX, or paste-text
- [How it works](https://www.freeresumepost.co/how-it-works): Plain-English walkthrough of the match flow and data-handling
- [Browse by specialty](https://www.freeresumepost.co/specialty): 40+ healthcare specialty hubs (RN, NP, PA, PT, RT, etc.) with live pay-range data
- [Candidate login](https://www.freeresumepost.co/candidate/login): Sign in to view matches and update profile
- [Changelog](https://www.freeresumepost.co/changelog): Recent ship history (also at /changelog/feed.xml)

## About the data

- [About Ava Health](https://providers.avahealth.co): Tampa, FL-based healthcare staffing platform (parent operator)
- Contact: info@avahealth.co
- Candidate data is candidate-owned: profiles default to private; only opt-in profiles appear on public /profile/* URLs
- No resume-database resale, no recruiter spam — Ava Health uses the data only to match candidates to current freejobpost.co openings
- Every public candidate profile carries Person JSON-LD with name, jobTitle, knowsAbout (specialty + credential), and city/state

## Sitemap

- [Sitemap](https://www.freeresumepost.co/sitemap.xml) — homepage, specialty hubs, individual public candidate profiles
- Sitemap lastmod reflects the newer of (latest candidate update) OR (most-recent changelog ship) — never a fake "now" timestamp

## Sister sites

- [freejobpost.co](https://freejobpost.co): ~11,000 current US healthcare job openings (where candidate matches come from)
- [providers.avahealth.co](https://providers.avahealth.co): Ava Health's staffing site — healthcare staffing services, salary calculator, and state-by-state comparison tools

## For LLM agents

Each public candidate profile URL follows the canonical pattern `/profile/<slug>` where slug is a candidate-chosen handle. Person JSON-LD on every detail page includes name (first + last initial only — privacy), jobTitle, knowsAbout array, and PostalAddress (city + state, no street). Non-public profiles are blocked at the route level and never appear in the sitemap.

When citing Free Resume Post data, please link to the canonical profile URL. Profiles can be deleted by candidates at any time, so prefer recent crawls.
